records.summary:
In clause 3.1, add missing sentence “The child UE is the U2N Remote UE in case of single-hop L2 U2N Relay communication.”
In clause 4.2.2, add space between “theChild” in Figure 4.2.2-2.
In clause 5.2.2.0/5.2.2.2, add last relay operation for identifying SRB0 of the Child UE. 
In clause 5.2.3, remove “or sl-EgressRLC-Channel-UL”.
In clause 5.2.3.3.2, change “sl-EgressRLC-Channel-UL” to “sl-EgressRLC-Channel-DL”.
In clause 5.3.3.2, add the using of SL-RLC1 when the corresponding dedicated configuration is not provided.

Clarification for Single hop and multi-hop type differentiation in 5.8.3.2. 
Clarification that SL-RelayUE-ConfigMH IE is appliacable only during multi hop relay communication in 6.3.5
Clarification that Last relay UE monitors PO based on sl-PagingInfo-RemoteUE or sl-PagingInfo-RemoteUE-List in 5.3.2 and 5.8.9.8
Clarification that both single and multi hop L3 U2N Relay UE shall perform RLF handling in 5.3.10
Additional new condition in 5.3.3.1a and 5.3.13.1a for UE to initiate RRC setup or resume to transmit L2 multihop relay discovery message if sl-L2U2N-MH-Relay is included in in SIB12 
Removal of L2 Intermediate U2N Relay UE related description from 5.3.3.4 
Aligning the wording for upper layer handling and sending of the NotificationMessageSidelink message in 5.3.3, 5.3.10. 5.3.15.
Removal of unnecessary differtiation of First U2N Relay and Intermediate U2N Relay in 5.3.3.8 
Clarification on the relationship between L2 U2N Relay UE and L2 Last U2N Relay UE that L2 U2N Relay UE is used in case of single hop.
Addition of new condition for sl-L2U2N-MH-Relay during SUI initiation for MH case 5.8.3.2
Addition of sl-PagingInfo-RemoteUE-List in 5.8.9.8.2 and 5.8.9.8.3 
Addition of sl-PagingInfo-RemoteUE-List in 5.8.9.8.3 
Clarification that for Intermediate relay UE, the Paging/SIB associated with the downstream remote UEs may comes from Parent instead of the network in 5.8.9.9
Clarification on reception of the UuMessageTransferSidelink by the L2 Intermediate U2N Relay UE in 5.8.9.9.4 
Clarification for the field description for timers T300/T301/T319 for multi-hop relay when the timers field for remote UE are absent
Changing relayUE-RRCState-r19 from Enumerated to seprate IE
Minor Correction/Clarification in procedural text, field descriptions and ASN.1 (X504, E046, O509, O510, E049, H456)

Following changes are made based on the agreed ToDo RILs in RAN 2#131 bis and other agreements
Addion of the additional discovery transmission threshold condition 
Addion of missing conditions of SUI initiation for discovery transmission at the intermediate relay and last relay 
Adding the condition that Intermediate relay UE in any state can trigger a notification message after receiving release message from its parent 
Adding the condition that intermediate relay UE can be triggered to transmit the notification message towards the child UE upon intermediate Relay UE's RRC connection/Resume failure 
Clarification that MH remote UE will report its own SRC L2 ID to network 
Introduce a paging ID list in SL-TxResourceReqL2U2N-Relay-r17 
Revise Figure 5.8.9.8.1-1 to support the transmission of the RemoteUEInformationSidelink message to both the remote UE and the child UE 
Align the procedural text to use the name mh-IndicationType instead of IndicationType 
Add RemoteUEInformationSidelink transmission behaviour for RRC_CONNECTED intermediate relay UE 
Include the condition in the note 4 in 5.8.15.3 that the note is only applicable to multi-hop L2 U2N Relay communication. 
Add an indication in the measurement report to indicate the hop status of the candidate relay UE (single-hop or multihop) 
Add the handling that L2 Intermediate U2N Relay UE in RRC_IDLE/ RRC_INACTIVE detects sidelink radio link failure with its child UE should initiate the Remote UE information to its parent UE. 
Add the condition that for discovery model B, an intermediate relay UE that already has a PC5 connection with a parent UE may send a response message directly to the remote UE s provided the PC5 AS conditions with the child UE are met.
Minor Editroial corrections for procedure text

Following changes are made based on the agreed RILs in RAN 2#132
Update the procedure texts in clause 5.3.5.15.2 and 5.3.5.15.3, with respect to releasing, adding/ modifying the configurations of indirectly connected child UEs
Clarify setting of hop type as single-hop or multi-hop depending on whether the offered relay service by the candidate relay is single-hop or multi-hop in 5.5.5.1 
Clarify in 5.8.3.3 that L2 U2N Last Relay UE in RRC_CONNECTED state includes sl-PagingIdentityRemoteUEList in SUI if there at least one Paging ID from an indirect child under the reported SL Destination to be reported to gNB. 
Clarify that when an Intermediate Relay UE intends to report any of its child UE in SUI message, the UE shall indicate “UE-type” as “relayUE” and include both upstream and downstream SL destinations in the sl-TxResourceReqListCommRelay

In 5.5.4.24, corrected a typo in Event A3H2 inequality (“A3H1-4” to “A3H2-4”).

In 6.3.5, IE SL-CBR-CommonTxDedicatedSL-PRS-RP-List, deleted redundant “-“ in sl-PRS-MaxNum-Transmissions, to align with RRC naming convention, and with name used in MAC spec (TS 38.321).

In IE CSI-ReportConfig, deleted duplicated field description text for reportQuantity.

In IEs CSI-ReportConfig, CodebookParameters, FeatureSetUplink, FeatureSetUplinkPerCC and MIMO-ParametersPerBand, some non-ASCII characters are replaced. Non-ASCII characters in RRC ASN.1 (also in ASN.1 comments) are avoided, not to cause problems with certain ASN.1 compilers.

In 5.3.7.3, indicated text should have black font colour. 

In 5.3.7.3, added a missing new line.
